EXHIBITS 62 SIGNATURES 63 WEBSITE DISCLOSURE Investors and others should note that we use our website, www.BrookfieldREIT.com , to announce material information to investors and the marketplace. While not all of the information that we post on our website is of a material nature, some information could be deemed to be material. Accordingly, we encourage investors, the media, and others interested in us to review the information that we share on our website.
